$comment: Digitexa UI registry. `npm run registry` compiles this into public/r/*.json. npm dependencies and `requires` are derived from each file's imports; list extra `requires` here only for things imports can't show.
name: digitexa-ui

items.name: theme
items.description: Tokens (light/dark, 6 accents, density) and the Tailwind v4 mapping.

items.name: utils
items.description: cn(): clsx + tailwind-merge, aware of the kit's font scale.

items.name: button
items.description: 6 variants, 6 sizes, asChild, never submits by accident.

items.name: input
items.description: 3 sizes, error state via aria-invalid.

items.name: textarea
items.description: Grows with its content.

items.name: label
items.description: Form label that dims with a disabled peer.

items.name: checkbox
items.description: Checked, unchecked and indeterminate.

items.name: switch
items.description: On/off toggle.

items.name: select
items.description: Accessible single select with groups and labels.

items.name: toggle-group
items.description: Segmented control with arrow-key navigation.

items.name: tabs
items.description: Segmented or underline tabs.

items.name: badge
items.description: Semantic and work status variants, StatusBadge.

items.name: status-icon
items.description: Status glyphs that show progress: backlog, to do, in progress, review, done.

items.name: avatar
items.description: Image with initials fallback, stable tint per name, AvatarGroup.

items.name: kbd
items.description: Keyboard shortcut hint.

items.name: card
items.description: Card with header/content/footer, plus StatGroup and Stat for key numbers.

items.name: table
items.description: Dense data table with density-aware rows.

items.name: progress
items.description: Thin progress bar with tones.

items.name: meter
items.description: Stacked distribution bar for status breakdowns and workload.

items.name: separator
items.description: Horizontal or vertical rule.

items.name: skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholder with a shimmer.

items.name: tooltip
items.description: Tooltip with a one-line shorthand.

items.name: popover
items.description: Floating panel anchored to a trigger.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.description: Menu with items, checkboxes, radios, shortcuts and submenus.

items.name: sidebar
items.description: App frame: AppShell, Sidebar with groups and items, Topbar.

items.name: dialog
items.description: Modal with header/body/footer, 3 sizes, scrolls when tall.
